scope: bounded alternatives, not admitted flagship; no actual commerce or calibrated physical claim

sources.title: Homometric Point Sets and Inverse Problems
sources.supports: Diffraction can be nonunique via equal autocorrelation; no solver reconstructs uniquely without justified added information.

sources.title: Phase Retrieval from Coded Diffraction Patterns
sources.supports: Modulation plus convex reconstruction is an existing complete noiseless theoretical route under stated admissibility/sample conditions; a new mask alone is not novelty.

sources.title: Reduction of artifacts associated with missing data in coherent diffractive imaging
sources.supports: Existing TVRAAR/ERHIO physical-model baselines with simulations and 3D experimental data; regularized selection is distinct from recovering unknown truth without additional assumptions.

sources.title: On the identifiability of the isoform deconvolution problem: application to select the proper fragment length in an RNA-seq library
sources.access: search returned abstract/body excerpt; full open redirected to inaccessible CDN
sources.supports: Existing gene/fragment/read-length identifiability test and mixed short/long library proposal. Conditions assume specified transcriptome and enough junction coverage.

sources.title: Long-read sequencing transcriptome quantification with lr-kallisto
sources.supports: Runnable strong conventional long-read pipeline; paper reports actual/simulated quantification. No claim that our role reproduced those outcomes.

sources.title: SIRV controls and official sequences
sources.supports: Independent assay-control product and sequencing record SRR3497201 exist; vendor page identifies current vs previous lot sequence versions.

sources.title: SIRV-Set2 product
sources.supports: Price requires login/quote; no observed price, AGI-ALPHA buyer orders, willingness-to-pay or task time is established.

rna.observed_evidence: Commercial RNA controls and published multi-tool benchmark demonstrate activity, not willingness to purchase our service.
rna.participation_frontier: conditional only; must include free lr-kallisto and assay costs

diffraction.observed_evidence: Experimental reconstruction research demonstrates useful work; no independent buyer/price evidence for an AGI ALPHA offering.
diffraction.participation_frontier: conditional only; hardware/calibration required and conventional coded acquisition competes

decisions.rna: RETAIN_ORDINARY_ROUTE_OR_BOUNDED_PROBE; no residual gap established; promising autonomous analysis service requires complete-cost/demand evidence.
decisions.diffraction: RETAIN_KNOWN_CODED_ACQUISITION; same-data uniqueness claim falsified in authored finite exact model; physical acquisition/calibration unavailable.
